retrieval_items.name: Latest annual report / 10-K / 20-F plus five years of cash-flow statements
Five years of proxy statements / governance and remuneration reports, read section by section
Four to eight earnings call transcripts with analyst Q&A
Filing feed: 24-month sweep of 8-K / 6-K / exchange announcements (RNS) and 36-month sweep for director departures (Item 5.02 or equivalent)
Merger proxy or registration statement for any pending transaction
Sector customer-harm registers from the sector pack (indicator 1.3)
Investor day and sector conference materials
ISS / Glass Lewis and Moody's / S&P / Fitch reports where reachable

event_sweep.query: {company} CEO steps down OR appointed chief executive
{company} board committee created OR renamed OR disbanded
{company} annual general meeting results OR shareholder vote
{company} regulator fine OR charges OR settlement
{company} pauses OR cancels OR scraps project
{company} acquisition OR divestment OR asset sale
{company} restructuring OR job cuts OR cost reduction
{company} credit rating downgrade OR upgrade OR outlook
{company} dividend OR buyback suspended OR cut OR raised
{company} strategy reset OR capital markets day OR investor day

1.1: Customer outcome measures in results, annual report KPIs
Whether analysts or management raise customer outcomes in Q&A
1.2: Disclosed board or director visits and who was met
Customer advisory board or director market visits
Whether visit findings are reported to the board
Directors with recent customer-facing executive roles
1.3: Register results (sector pack) and legal-proceedings note
How the company acknowledged or remediated
Disclosed watch list or escalation process
1.4: Any reduction for a missed quality metric, at corporate AND individual award level (read the individual award narrative)
Whether the scorecard applies below the C-suite
2.1: Material revisions in 36 months, with dates
Activist stakes, low votes, guidance misses, underperformance, with dates
2.2: KPI or non-GAAP definition changes and explanations
SEC comment letters, short-seller or analyst critiques
How the board tests metrics against reality
2.3: Governance-guideline wording on access to management and advisors
Regular sessions with leaders below the C-suite
Advisors appointed by the board or committees
2.4: Committees created, renamed, merged or dissolved over five years
Reviews of charters, terms of reference, reserved matters
3.1: Two or three named structural shifts and the company position on each
Targets and the board body overseeing each
3.2: The two or three sector shocks in the 24-month window, with dates
Company move dates against each peer's move dates
3.3: Skills matrix against the named shifts
Appointments in window and how sourced
Outside experts, customers or investors brought into the board
3.4: Capex, R&D and M&A behind each stated position over five years
4.1: Delegation of authority and matters reserved
Initiatives announced, scaled, paused or stopped in 24 months, with dates and months elapsed
4.2: Large M&A, CEO selection, leverage decisions in 24 months
Impairments, write-offs or loss-making exits following those decisions
Deals or decisions deferred or declined
4.3: Departures and stated reasons (Item 5.02 or equivalent)
Proxy contests, publicly disputed departures, failed board resolutions
5.2: Average tenure, directors added over five years
Age or term limits and any waivers
5.3: Internal or externally facilitated; date of last external review
Meetings held and share of capital engaged
Proxy access, special meetings, classified board, auto-vote programmes, redomiciliation
Low votes and the board's response
5.4: Revenue or margin pressure episodes in 24 months, with dates
First levers pulled: cost, reinvestment, pricing, portfolio, guidance
6.1: Weight of cash metrics in annual and long-term incentives
Five-year operating cash flow or FCF against net income
6.2: Leverage measure, date and peer comparison on the same basis
Maturity profile, committed liquidity, working-capital trend
6.3: Refinancing, divestment and cost actions with dates
Downgrades, misses, leverage peaks with dates
Stated liquidity or leverage policy and triggers
